title: Apple HomeView
summary: Apple HomeView is a new smart home interface introduced at WWDC 2024, serving as Apple's centralized control center for managing HomeKit-compatible devices, featuring redesigned widgets and improved automation capabilities across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV.
problem_solved: Provides a unified, intuitive interface for controlling diverse smart home devices across the Apple ecosystem.
why_valuable: Delivers seamless cross-device smart home management with tight Apple ecosystem integration and privacy-focused design.
